summary: Antivirus pioneer John McAfee hyped computer-virus fears to sell software, then drifted through drug-fuelled ventures in Belize, where he was accused of rape and suspected in a neighbour's 2012 killing, before fleeing into fringe politics and exile.
keywords: Gringo: The Dangerous Life of John McAfee

evidence.note: born in Gloucestershire, England to an American father, raised in Virginia
first meets the Brain virus at Lockheed and builds the first commercial antivirus
inflates Michelangelo virus damage estimates in the press to drive sales
nephew and a student die in a crash at his unlicensed flight school
claims to lose his fortune and moves assets and himself to Belize
Belizean police raid his jungle lab on suspicion of drug production
Adonizio's allegation that he drugged and raped her before she left
neighbour Greg Faull found shot dead; McAfee becomes the main suspect
arrested in Guatemala after Vice photo metadata leaks, then deported to the US
runs for president as a Libertarian; campaign videos described
reporting that he was binging the legal stimulant alpha-PHP
flees a claimed tax case by boat to the Bahamas in early 2019

notes: McAfee was alive at release (died 2021), so covered_span ends at 2019 and main_span is open-ended. The 16-year-old sex worker he took up with in Belize (legal age there) gets a short segment; child-abuse was left out as the story does not frame it as abuse at length. Faull's birth year is not given.
